verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly confirm self-hosting on consumer hardware via Docker or Pip, offline chat models via Ollama/LiteLLM, admin panel configuration, and full privacy assurance that data never leaves the device; community evidence corroborates users running it locally (with some setup friction like a docker build failure). Missing for 10: independent verification that self-hosted deployment matches full feature parity with the hosted cloud version, and resolution of the reported docker build issue.
